Class H3CellColorResolver

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.renderers.H3CellColorResolver
public class H3CellColorResolver extends Object
High-performance color shader and analytical metric resolver for hexagonal planetary cells.

Extracted from H3MapCanvas to fulfill the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) by isolating thematic visual rendering, scientific false-color gradients, terrain hillshading, solar terminator computation, and multi-layer optical blending into a dedicated, reusable shader module.

Mathematical Foundations:

  • Solar Terminator: Approximates cosine insolation \(\cos(\theta_z) = \sin(\phi)\sin(\delta) + \cos(\phi)\cos(\delta)\cos(h)\)
  • Hillshading (Lambertian): \(\cos(\psi) = \frac{\nabla z \cdot L}{\|\nabla z\| \|L\|}\)
  • Carrying Capacity: \(K_{\text{cell}} = K_0 \cdot \beta_{\text{biome}} \cdot (1 + \alpha W) \cdot f(T)\)

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
